content.title: ‘The Voice’ Season 29 Winner Has Been Crowned. Find Out Who Won
content.text: Another season of “The Voice” is over and that means we have a new winner.The Season 29 finale of “The Voice: Battle of Champions” aired on April 14 with four singers and their coaches competing to be named the Voice.Season 29 included a new format with only three coaches — Kelly Clarkson, John Legend and Adam Levine — new challenges, voting rules and alumni returning. For the first time ever, a new voting block of super fans and past artists had a chance to vote in real-time to determine which finalist would be crowned the winner.Find out who won “The Voice” and what happened in the Season 29 finale. Who Were the Top 4 Artists Heading Into 'The Voice' Season 29 Finalists?Heading into the Season 29 “The Voice” finale, each coach had a finalist. Team Kelly had double the opportunity to win with two artists competing.Team Adam finalist: Alexia Jayy Team Legend finalist: Lucas WestTeam Kelly finalists: Liv Ciara and Mikenley BrownWhat Happened During ‘The Voice’ Season 29 Finale?Each finalist got the chance to perform two songs during the finale. They also sang a duet with their coaches. See what each singer performed below:Team Adam’s Alexia Jayy kicked off the final episode by singing “Lady Marmalade” and closed with “One and Only.” She and Levine also sang “Sunday Morning” together.Team Kelly’s Mikenley Brown sang “Almost Is Never Enough” and “Man I Need.” Clarkson and Brown then performed “What Was I Made For.”Team Legend’s Lucas West followed with “Cold As Ice” and his coach’s tune “Ordinary People.” For their duet, they sang “Don’t Let the Sun Go Down on Me.”Team Kelly’s Liv Ciara closed the first round with “The Greatest” and sang “What A Girl Wants” as her second song. She also sang “Stay” with Clarkson.Who Was ‘The Voice’ Season 29 Winner?The winner for Season 29 of “The Voice” was Alexia Jayy. This was a win for Team Adam.Alexia Jayy was crowned the winner of "The Voice" Season 29.NBC / Griffin Nagel/NBCIn second place was Team Kelly’s Liv Ciara. Lucas West came in third, while Mikenley Brown came in fourth.Aside from her big win, the 31-year-old from Irvington, Alabama, will be releasing her new single, “Rent Free,” on April 15. Reaction to Alexia Jayy Winning ‘The Voice’Jayy’s win made history on “The Voice,” as several fans celebrated on the show’s Instagram clip announcing the winner that she is the first Black woman to be crowned winner.“The first African American woman to ever win this show! Thank you Alexia for winning for us ✨🤎” Season 22 contestant Kim Cruse wrote.“She made history as the first African American woman winner to win the show! I love her so much! I cannot wait for her album! 🙌🔥” another fan commented.“First BLACK WOMAN to win The Voice! ❤️” someone else exclaimed.Jayy herself was overcome by the victory.“It’s going to take me a little minute to really process all of it, but just a little bit, and I am feeling unreal right now. Everything is feeling unreal,” she told “Extra” after the show.Levine also basked in the afterglow of her win.“She deserves it all. And I’m not just being humble for the sake of being humble, because this woman moved us all so much tonight, and every night,” he told “Extra” when he joined Jayy during her interview. “But tonight was a really special night.”Who Are the Coaches for ‘The Voice’ Season 30?It appears “The Voice” will return for Season 30 this fall. Following the Season 29 finale, the show announced that Levine would be returning as a coach.
